mapper.sql: a.status = 1 AND a.visibility = 1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.publish_time IS NOT NULL AND a.publish_time <= #{now}
a.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_article_like l WHERE l.article_id = a.article_id) AS like_count
mapper.select:
SELECT a.* FROM blog_article a SELECT FROM blog_article a JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = a.author_id
WHERE a.article_id = #{id} AND a.author_id = #{author} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.* FROM blog_article a SELECT FROM blog_article a JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = a.author_id
WHERE a.slug = #{slug} AND FOR UPDATE
SELECT a.* FROM blog_article a WHERE a.article_id = #{id} AND
SELECT t.* FROM blog_tag t JOIN blog_article_tag r ON r.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE r.article_id = #{id} ORDER BY t.tag_id
SELECT t.tag_id FROM blog_tag t JOIN blog_article_tag r ON r.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE r.article_id = #{id} ORDER BY t.tag_id FOR SHARE
SELECT category_id FROM blog_category WHERE category_id = #{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT tag_id FROM blog_tag WHERE tag_id = #{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT * FROM blog_file WHERE file_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM blog_file WHERE file_id = #{id} AND uploader_id = #{uploader}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_article_content(article_id, markdown_content, html_content) VALUES(#{id}, #{markdown}, #{html}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE markdown_content = #{markdown}, html_content = #{html}
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_article SET view_count = view_count + 1, update_time = update_time WHERE article_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.publish_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS article_count FROM blog_article a WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.publish_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC

SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.slug FROM blog_article a WHERE
AND (a.publish_time < #{article.publishTime} OR (a.publish_time = #{article.publishTime} AND a.article_id < #{article.articleId})) ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC, a.article_id DESC
AND (a.publish_time > #{article.publishTime} OR (a.publish_time = #{article.publishTime} AND a.article_id > #{article.articleId})) ORDER BY a.publish_time ASC, a.article_id ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT comment_id, parent_id, status FROM blog_comment WHERE article_id = #{id}
